section: Democratic decentralisation - meaning, objectives and preconditions

accepted.s: Which campaign is associated with strengthening women’s leadership in Panchayati Raj Institutions?
accepted.x: Sashakt Panchayat Netri Abhiyan is associated with strengthening women’s leadership in Panchayati Raj Institutions.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the exact name of a current governance initiative.

accepted.s: Under the Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayats initiative, the intended coverage is:
o: At least one Gram Panchayat in every district
At least one Zilla Parishad in every district
Every Gram Panchayat in every State
One Gram Panchayat only in each State capital
accepted.x: The initiative envisages at least one Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayat per district.
accepted.tq: Test the precise coverage condition rather than the broad objective.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding recent priorities in Panchayati Raj Institutions:
1. PRI own-source revenue has been stressed in the Economic Survey 2025–26.
2. e-GramSwaraj has been identified as a digital governance priority.
3. SabhaSaar is associated with Gram Sabha minutes through an AI tool.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Economic Survey 2025–26 stresses PRI own-source revenue, e-GramSwaraj and SabhaSaar; SabhaSaar is described as an AI tool for preparing Gram Sabha minutes.
accepted.tq: Combine closely related policy priorities and identify the all-correct combination.

accepted.s: SabhaSaar, in the context of Gram Sabha functioning, is associated with:
o: Conduct of elections to Jammu and Kashmir DDCs
Collection of property tax by Zilla Parishads
Preparation of Gram Sabha minutes using an artificial intelligence tool
accepted.x: SabhaSaar is an AI tool associated with Gram Sabha minutes.
accepted.tq: Use the function of a named digital tool to distinguish it from unrelated Panchayati Raj activities.

accepted.s: A report dated 1 July 2026 highlighted which concern relating to Gram Sabhas?
o: Low participation in Gram Sabha meetings
Excessive own-source revenue of Gram Panchayats
Completion of all DDC elections in Jammu and Kashmir
Reduction in the number of Zilla Parishads in Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The report referred to low participation in Gram Sabha meetings and was associated with LENSD.
accepted.tq: Directly test the reported governance problem and its date-linked context.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Jammu and Kashmir District Development Councils (DDCs):
1. Their term ended on 24 February 2026.
2. Fresh elections had not been held by the time reported.
3. Their term was extended through a fresh election conducted immediately after its expiry.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The J&K DDCs’ term ended on 24 February 2026, and no fresh polls had taken place. The statement about an immediate fresh election is incorrect.
accepted.tq: Find the false continuation of a true date-and-event statement.

accepted.s: Panchayati Raj was initiated in Andhra Pradesh on:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh began Panchayati Raj on 1 November 1959. The date 2 October 1959 is associated with the first State to introduce Panchayati Raj, Rajasthan.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two closely related Panchayati Raj dates and events.

accepted.s: Which State was the first in India to introduce Panchayati Raj?
accepted.x: Rajasthan was the first State to introduce Panchayati Raj, on 2 October 1959.
accepted.tq: Test the first-in-sequence fact together with its associated State.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer.

List-I (Event)
a. Introduction of Panchayati Raj in the first State
b. Beginning of Panchayati Raj in Andhra Pradesh
c. Creation of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj

a. 2 October 1959
b. 1 November 1959
c. 27 May 2004

List-II (Date)
i. 27 May 2004
ii. 1 November 1959
iii. 2 October 1959

The correct matching is:
accepted.x: Rajasthan’s introduction of Panchayati Raj was on 2 October 1959; Andhra Pradesh began it on 1 November 1959; and the Ministry of Panchayati Raj was created on 27 May 2004.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure date-event pairs and eliminate codes with swapped dates.
